main_finding: ATAC explicitly adopts coupled Tn5 fragmentation and adapter tagging, changes the substrate/context to native unfixed nuclei, and uses accessibility-dependent sampling as the measurement. This is a scoped component adoption, not exact chemical-interface equivalence or proof of a whole-assay parent.
harness_failure_and_correction: Version 1 rejected all nonempty uncertainty lists, including external identity and unclaimed recipe-equivalence limits. Version 2 requires a fresh blocking/nonblocking assessment for every issue, preserves all qualifications, and retains background exclusion. The scientific analysis and sources were unchanged.
limitations: This is one selected method, not a measured generalization or accuracy result.
Reference retrieval used registered PubMed/PMC access; abstracts are not full papers and publisher recovery is incomplete.
Review is by independent model sessions, not an independent human expert.
Catalogue matches remain candidates, including grouped FAIRE/Sono labels.
No canonical graph merge or before-side full workflow extraction was performed.
Date and preprint-version handling is proposed and not implemented.
date_and_workflow_decision: Inventory all Illumina entries first; then pair each diagram with primary-paper reading and targeted backward reference tracing. Use the first public version containing a claimed feature, retain journal dates separately, and treat dates as direction constraints rather than ancestry evidence. Similarity and descendant searches can include later methods.
